description: Security requirements register for 0xCMS (W14; A.8.25, A.8.26, A.8.29). Each requirement states behaviour the CMS must keep, the Annex A controls it serves, and the regression tests that prove it. tools/check-requirements.mjs fails CI when a named test no longer exists, so a test cannot be renamed or deleted without the register changing in the same review. Owners and acceptance are organisational and stay null until assigned.

requirements.requirement: Only a correctly signed HS256 access token with the expected issuer, audience and type is accepted; refresh tokens and alg:none or other algorithms are refused.

tests.title: refuses a refresh token presented as the access token
refuses %s
rejects tokens without iss/aud even when correctly signed

requirements.requirement: A role change or account removal takes effect on existing tokens at their next request.

tests.title: applies a role change to an existing access token on its next request
refuses every outstanding token once the account is removed
denies a demoted account using its old administrator token

requirements.requirement: Rotating JWT_SECRET invalidates every outstanding token, and a secret too short to sign with is refused.

tests.title: refuses tokens signed with the previous secret
refuses a secret too short to sign with

requirements.requirement: A session idle beyond SESSION_IDLE_TTL is refused and purged; background requests do not extend it.

tests.title: refuses to refresh a session idle beyond its window
rotates on a background refresh without moving the idle deadline
closes an open socket on the next sweep once its session goes idle

requirements.requirement: Admin pages run only nonce-bearing scripts, with a fresh nonce per request.

tests.title: serves admin pages with a per-request nonce and no unsafe sources
uses a fresh nonce per request

requirements.requirement: A page classified phi, by type, taxonomy or sensitivity floor, is never published, and publication fails closed when classification cannot be read.

tests.title: refuses a page whose type is classified phi
refuses an ordinary page tagged from a classified taxonomy
refuses everything when the classification cannot be read

requirements.requirement: Media under a phi prefix is never served on public routes, cannot be told apart from a missing object, and only media:regulated holders read it.

tests.title: withholds an object under a phi prefix
cannot be told apart from a missing object
answers 503, not 404, when the classification cannot be read
refuses an editor, who may upload media but not read regulated media

requirements.requirement: Personal data is masked for viewers without pii:reveal, and a cleartext disclosure is recorded.

tests.title: never sends the cleartext to a viewer without pii:reveal
records cleartext disclosure separately from the list read

requirements.requirement: A regulated deployment refuses service until its inventory, schema and bindings are complete.

tests.title: guards real HTTP requests before route work and recovers after inventory repair
rejects a build without the audit feature

requirements.requirement: Authentication refusals are recorded durably without copying codes, state or attempted credentials.

tests.title: persists an attributable bounded OAuth refusal before returning its redirect
does not record OAuth codes, state, query terms or attempted addresses

requirements.requirement: The audit archive seals each range once, never forks the chain and never prunes what it has not read back.

tests.title: cannot fork the chain from a runner whose lease lapsed mid-write
does not prune a segment that cannot be read back
seals each range once when ticks overlap

requirements.requirement: A plugin cannot inherit another plugin's identity or approvals, and cannot expand its access without host approval.

tests.title: does not let an impostor inherit the approvals granted to the id
rejects manifest access expansion without host approval

requirements.requirement: A one-time form token is accepted exactly once and only with this deployment's signature.

tests.title: serializes concurrent claims so exactly one request wins
rejects tokens signed with a different secret without storing them

requirements.requirement: With the private database unreachable, nothing is served, changed or re-issued on the token's word.

tests.title: refuses an admin read with a valid access token
issues no new tokens from a refresh token

requirements.requirement: A purged submission is erased from the published database and never re-mirrored; a held page is never purged.

tests.title: is mirrored, trashed without coming back, then purged and erased from the published database
refuses to purge a held page by hand, by empty trash and by retention, until released

requirements.requirement: Flagged signals reach the receiver without personal data, and a review is recorded with its decision.

tests.title: sends a flagged signal once a day, with counts and no personal data
records the decision, clears the overdue flag and reports both in the heartbeat
